intro: The Pi-side dossier of the program-triage-2026-10-22 group behind wb-x0xu.2 (HX-STRUCTURAL-INFORMATION-OPTIMIZATION-R2), from the owner filing on that bead. It records the status words of two HyperUnix-CLI design programs at the filing's pin, HyperUnix-CLI commit 0091719d02887910fa0c2fb6693a32723e243600, read with read-only git show. CSO is docs/programs/certified-structural-optimization-2026-10-18 and SIO is docs/programs/structural-information-optimization-2026-10-17.
test/workbench-hx-sio-design-status-census.test.ts judges every sentence here beside the pages it judges, and holds each status row to its program line byte for byte.

posture: Pi never presents HXSI-01 to HXSI-06, a TI- row or hx.optim.spoke.exchange.v1 as a registered or admitted runtime law, a selected hx plan route, Lean-elaborated or benchmarked: the programs call them DESIGN ONLY, not implemented, human proof and Lean source authored only.
The proposed hx.optim.spoke.exchange.v1 record names certificate_refs TI-23, and CSO README.md:83 reads that all law admissions remain blocked.

If an HX result ever carries law_id or certificate_refs, Pi echoes them byte for byte and mints no admission or verification status. Today the vendored @hyperunix/sdk 0.1.0 keeps them only in its extensions sidecar, which the hyperunix.find provider output echoes verbatim and the reader adapter never reads.
